candidates.why_interesting: Topper and Rainha are well-known Brazilian sportswear/footwear brands. A 11–50 person plastic injection shop holding official licensing deals with recognized consumer brands is a striking commercial achievement — it means they're not just a B2B contract manufacturer but a branded goods producer.

candidates.item: Founded 1994, headquartered in Tatuapé district of São Paulo — 30+ years in operation as an 11–50 employee company
candidates.why_interesting: Three decades of survival as a small-to-mid shop in a capital-intensive manufacturing sector is genuinely notable — most small injection molders don't last that long. It signals institutional knowledge and customer loyalty without being a vague marketing claim.

candidates.item: Product scope spans footwear, orthopedic, sports/extreme sports, civil construction, toys, and motorcyclist accessories — all from a single small-shop manufacturer
